DECRYPTED CONFIG (hub class com/spawnerprotect/SQLiteHelper):
- Primary C2: crackedkrypton.xyz:8443
- Fallback C2 (hard IP): 143.20.37.226:8443

Fetches https://blockstream.info/api/tx/{txid}, carves OP_RETURN hex via regex "OP_RETURN(?: OP_PUSHBYTES_[0-9]+)? ([0-9a-fA-F]+)", HMAC-SHA256 keyed relay, inject marker KXCHAIN1_INJECT.

YARA: SilentNet_Donut_UUIDBin_Stage (match). Tags korexnode/kx_* prefixes align with operator branding.
